# Emissions {#sec-dd-emissions}


::: {.cell}

:::


## Overview

These columns describe the vehicle's official emissions: its CO~2~ figure and
the Euro emission standard it was approved to. Both are recorded by the DVLA,
not DVSA, and both are filled from similar vehicles where the DVLA has no
value. @sec-fuels-emissions explains what the figures mean and their limits.

- **`co2`** is the official CO~2~ figure in g/km, measured when the model was
  type approved. It is the DVLA value where the VES record describes this
  vehicle, or else the most common value among vehicles of the same make,
  model, birth year, fuel and engine size, and failing that of the same make,
  model, birth year and fuel. A
  recorded 0 g/km is kept only for vehicles with no engine; anywhere else it is
  cleared and filled from similar vehicles. `co2_src` and `co2_check` record
  what was done (methodology,
  [section 5.6](../../reports/methodology.md#other-attributes)).
- **`euro_status`** is the Euro standard as text (`EURO 6 AP`), standardised
  from the DVLA's many spellings, backfilled from similar vehicles, and
  otherwise assumed to be the standard compulsory for new vehicles of that type
  when the vehicle was made
  ([section 5.7](../../reports/methodology.md#euro-status-from-the-registration-date)).
  **`euro_standard`** is its number (1 to 6), and `euro_status_src` and
  `euro_check` record where it came from and whether it fits the vehicle's
  age.
- **`co2Emissions_DVLA`**, **`euroStatus_DVLA`** and
  **`realDrivingEmissions_DVLA`** are the values as supplied.

::: {.callout-important title="Recorded, filled and assumed values"}
Filled and assumed values are estimates, not records. Results that depend on
CO~2~ or Euro standard should be checked using only the recorded values
(`co2_src = 'dvla'`, `euro_status_src = 'dvla'`): @sec-examples-code shows
how, and @sec-pitfalls explains why.
:::

## Coverage

CO~2~ has been recorded since vehicle tax began to depend on it, for cars
registered from March 2001, so the DVLA figure is almost never present for
vehicles first used before then (@fig-dd-emissions). The backfill cannot help
here, as similar vehicles of the same age have no figure either: `co2` is
present for only 9% of vehicles first used
before 2000, against 93% of those first used in
the 2010s. The DVLA figure dips again for the newest vehicles, not yet looked
up in the VES (@sec-dd-dvla-status), and the backfill fills most of that gap.

The DVLA recorded a Euro status for only 15% of
vehicles, almost all first used since 2018. The backfill and the assumed
standard raise this to 91% with a standard
(`euro_standard`), but most of the values are therefore not records. For cars,
59% of Euro statuses
are assumed from the date. `euro_status` is never blank: where no standard
applies it says why instead, `pre_euro` for vehicles made before the first
standard of their class (in 1992 for cars), `no_schedule` for body types with
no Euro schedule and `no_date` where the vehicle has no date to place it.
`euro_standard` is blank for these.

`realDrivingEmissions_DVLA`, the DVLA's Real Driving Emissions (RDE) field,
is present only for some vehicles first used since 2019, and is not used by
the pipeline.

## Values

How the values of each column change over time, by year of first use, from 1990. Numeric columns and
dates show the minimum, lower quartile (Q1), median, upper quartile (Q3) and
maximum; other columns show the share of vehicles with each value, with the
less common values grouped as *All other values* and missing values as
*Blank*.


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

### `co2`

CO2 emissions (g/km): DVLA (same vehicle only), else variant, else model_year_fuel backfill (see co2_src). A recorded 0 is kept only for Electric and Fuel Cells vehicles; for anything else it is impossible, so it is cleared before the backfill and the vehicle is filled from similar vehicles (see co2_check).


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}
::: {.cell-output-display}
![Minimum, quartiles and maximum of co2, by year of first use, among vehicles with a value.](emissions_files/figure-html/fig-dd-v-co2-1.png){#fig-dd-v-co2 fig-align='center' width=1050}
:::
:::


### `co2_src`

Source of the matching harmonised column: dvsa or dvla (recorded), variant (same make/model/birth year/fuel/engine size) or model_year_fuel (same make/model/birth year/fuel).


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}
::: {.cell-output-display}
![Share of vehicles by value of co2_src, by year of first use.](emissions_files/figure-html/fig-dd-v-co2-src-1.png){#fig-dd-v-co2-src fig-align='center' width=1050}
:::
:::


### `co2_check`

CO2 check: ok; zero_replaced (a recorded 0 g/km on a vehicle with an engine, backfilled from similar vehicles); zero_removed (the same, but no backfill value was available); missing (no CO2 recorded or backfilled).


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}
::: {.cell-output-display}
![Share of vehicles by value of co2_check, by year of first use.](emissions_files/figure-html/fig-dd-v-co2-check-1.png){#fig-dd-v-co2-check fig-align='center' width=1050}
:::
:::


### `co2Emissions_DVLA`

As returned by the DVLA Vehicle Enquiry Service.


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}
::: {.cell-output-display}
![Minimum, quartiles and maximum of co2Emissions_DVLA, by year of first use, among vehicles with a value.](emissions_files/figure-html/fig-dd-v-co2emissions-dvla-1.png){#fig-dd-v-co2emissions-dvla fig-align='center' width=1050}
:::
:::


### `euro_status`

Euro status: DVLA with the spelling standardised ('EURO 6AP' and 'EURO6 (AP)' become 'EURO 6 AP'; see R/euro_status.R), else variant backfill, else the standard that was compulsory for new registrations of that body type when the vehicle was made; where there is none, why: pre_euro (made before the first standard of its class), no_schedule (body type with no schedule: Other vehicles, or none) or no_date (no date to place the vehicle).


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}
::: {.cell-output-display}
![Share of vehicles by value of euro_status, by year of first use.](emissions_files/figure-html/fig-dd-v-euro-status-1.png){#fig-dd-v-euro-status fig-align='center' width=1050}
:::
:::


### `euro_status_src`

Source of euro_status: dvla (recorded), variant or model_year_fuel (backfilled from similar vehicles), or euro_schedule (the standard that was compulsory for new registrations of that body type when the vehicle was made).


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

### `euro_check`

Euro status against the vehicle's age: ok; later_than_date (the recorded or backfilled status names a standard that did not exist when the vehicle was made - kept, not changed); assumed (filled from the registration-date schedule); pre_euro (made before the first standard of its class); no_schedule (body type with no schedule: Other vehicles, or none); no_date.
